notes: No og:image or twitter:image on the homepage and no clear key-art banner among the hero images (several are unlabeled square photos); used the site logo as the cover. Refute pass (2026-10-05): fresh re-fetch confirms all 18 cards unchanged, each still reading 'Appearing: Friday, Saturday, Sunday' against the same page's own Jan 15-17, 2027 schedule table, with photos uploaded 2026/07-2026/09 (pipeline/cache/extract/game-on-expo-v2.guests.json, #1-18); a search shows Game On Expo's most recent past edition ran Mar 13-15, 2026 with a completely different ~30-name roster (Cody Christian, Tyler Hoechlin, Doug Cockle, Jennifer English, etc., per phoenixnewtimes.com), so this is not that lineup carried over stale; upheld.
